column2: [intro]
I tried the piano, but it sounds so strange,
The guitar’s not better, it hurts my fingers, quite deranged.
Drums? No thanks, they take up too much space,
Musical instruments just aren’t my taste.
No instrument captures my interest fully,
I’d rather sing, let the wind carry me truly.
No need for notes, I make my voice ring,
And I promise you, it sounds pretty good, I sing!
I tried the flute, but I made a mess,
The saxophone was worse, it scared the whole neighborhood, I confess.
The trumpet was a disaster, it frightens the animals too,
Musical instruments, I leave them to others, it’s more fun to do.
No instrument captures my interest fully,
I’d rather sing, let the wind carry me truly.
No need for notes, I make my voice ring,
And I promise you, it sounds pretty good, I sing!
[ solo ]
Some might say I lack the skill,
That I should practice, refine, and fulfill.
But I reply with a cheeky grin,
Music is a joy that’s childlike within.
[outro]
